_about: Notes shown beside a contract section (Ben, Nov 21 2026: explainers, what it meant when we negotiated it, cases and grievances). Each note: units = list of unit codes (or "all"), section = "10.1", kind = explain | intent | case, title (optional), text, date and outcome (optional, for cases: subject only, never an employee's name), href = the case's page (more = its link words), draft = true to show only in a build run with --drafts. Later the Union App sends the cases.

notes.title: Talking to Your Union in Private
notes.date: FLRA v. Michigan Army National Guard, 878 F.3d 171 (6th Cir. 2017)
notes.text: The Guard told the union not to talk to employees without a Guard attorney present. A federal appeals court upheld the ruling that its sweeping ban broke the law.
notes.more: Read the Case and Hear the Argument

notes.title: MSPB Relief for Technicians
notes.date: Erdel v. Department of the Army, 2023 MSPB 27
notes.text: The Board ruled that it can order the Army or the Air Force to give a dual status technician relief, and that the old court decision saying otherwise is no longer the law. A Local 1776 case.

notes.title: Pay for Higher-Graded Work
notes.date: Nevada Army National Guard and LIUNA Local 1776, 74 FLRA 219 (2025)
notes.text: A Nevada employee did a higher-graded job for six years without the pay. The Guard said it could not be grieved. The FLRA let the back pay award stand.

notes.title: When It Is Too Late for an Election
notes.text: LIUNA asked for an election in Illinois the day before another union and the Guard signed their contract. The FLRA ruled it was on time.

notes.title: Changing National Unions
notes.date: New Mexico Army and Air National Guard, 56 FLRA 145 (2000)
notes.text: New Mexico members voted 40 to 4 to leave their national union for LIUNA. The FLRA upheld their choice over the old union’s objection.
